case: Water drop impact into a deep pool, Santini et al. experimental case 3
figure: 5, experimental asterisks only, both growth and recoil
diameter_basis: Original experimental Table 2, case 3, single drop. Case 4 is a pair of drops.
material_basis: Uniform liquid at the measured drop properties (27 °C), as used for the experimental dimensionless groups. Pool water properties are archived separately. Air properties are nominal.

gates.time_origin: first connected liquid bridge, no subsequent time shift
gates.coverage: all positive-depth experimental observations, growth, peak and recoil; no extrapolation
gates.impact_speed_measurement: Use the displacement of the projected drop contour centre over the last 1 ms before contact. Record the whole-flight centre fit and liquid-core velocity as diagnostics. A missing frame pair prevents verification.

reference_data.notes: Conservative image-reading allowance, not an experimental confidence interval. The paper reports experimental data as markers. No experimental timing offset or depth rescaling is fitted.
